WE ARE GRAIN!

Who we are

Grain is a Tel Aviv–based startup building technology that makes global commerce smoother and smarter. We’re tackling complex financial workflows with a product mindset: data-driven, scalable, and designed for growth. Our team brings together builders from tech and finance, united by the belief that elegant technology can solve real-world business challenges.

We’re backed by leading venture capital firms and prominent financial institutions. That support gives us the runway and ambition to grow fast and the stability to invest in our people.

Life at Grain

Impact from day one

Career acceleration
